verdict.rationale: Langfuse traces support user and session tracking plus tags/metadata, and cost/usage tracking is automatic with dashboards that break down cost by model, tags, or users, plus an aggregate Metrics API for querying cost/usage by dimensions. This directly supports attributing cost/usage to users, sessions, and features via metadata/tags. Missing for 10: no explicit example of arbitrary custom metadata fields (beyond tags/users/sessions) being used for cost attribution, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific attribution workflow.
